AUMA, multi-turn actuators SA 07.2-SA 16.2 / SAR 07.2-SAR 16.2, operation instructions Y004.750/003 (PR00242/en/1.26): fitting the handwheel §5.2 p. 13, output drive type A (a mounting flange with the stem nut in an axial bearing, taking the thrust) §5.3.2 pp. 14-17, servicing §13 pp. 46-47

body.name: Valve body
body.does: Holds the pressure and turns the flow up through the seat and out again. It stays welded or bolted in its pipe when the valve is opened.

seat_ring.name: Seat ring
seat_ring.does: The ring the disc closes on. It stays in the body: the maintenance steps never take it out.

disc.name: Disc
disc.does: The closure member: lowered onto the seat ring it shuts the flow; lifted, it opens it a little at a time. It hangs on the stem's end, held by a lock nut or a pin.

stem.name: Stem
stem.does: Lifts and lowers the disc. Its thread runs in the actuator's stem nut; a block on it in the yoke's window points to the travel on the yoke's scale.

bonnet.name: Bonnet and yoke
bonnet.does: Closes the body over the disc on its gasket, carries the packing box round the stem, and the actuator on its yoke's top flange.

packing.name: Packing, gland and gland flange
packing.does: Rings of graphite packing squeezed round the stem by the gland under the gland flange, so the process cannot leak along the stem.
packing.material: Graphite rings, steel gland and flange

actuator.name: Electric actuator
actuator.does: A motor and a worm gear that turn the stem nut, with its limit and torque switches and local controls. It is one part here: its maker's service opens it.

stem_nut.name: Stem nut (output drive type A)
stem_nut.does: Turns in the actuator's output drive on its thrust bearing and drives the stem up or down; it carries the valve's thrust into the actuator's flange.

display.name: Local display
display.does: Shows the valve's position and the actuator's state beside its local controls.

handwheel.name: Handwheel
handwheel.does: Works the valve by hand when the motor is not running.

text: The body stays in its pipe.
why: The bonnet, the stem and the disc all come out upwards, without disturbing the pipe.

text: The seat ring stays in the body: look at its face for cuts and wear.
why: Crane's steps never take the seat ring out of the body.
needs: body
The seat ring is in the body.
The body stays in its pipe.

text: Set the disc on the seat ring.
needs: seat_ring
The disc closes on the seat ring: it is there first.
Lift the disc out before anything is done to the seat ring.

text: Put the stem's end into the disc and fix the disc on it with its lock nut or pin.
why: In the shop the disc is fixed on the stem and goes in with the bonnet assembly; the steps here fit each part in its place.
needs: disc
The stem carries the disc: put the disc in first.
Free the disc from the stem (its lock nut's tack welds ground off, or its pin out) before the disc comes out.

text: Fit a new bonnet gasket and lower the bonnet over the stem onto the body.
needs: stem
The bonnet goes on over the stem: put the stem in first.
Lift the bonnet off before the stem comes out.

text: Fit the bonnet studs and nuts and tighten them evenly, crosswise.
needs: bonnet
The nuts hold the bonnet down: set it on first.
Take the bonnet nuts off before the bonnet is lifted.

text: Put new packing rings over the stem into the packing box, then the gland and the gland flange, and tighten the gland bolts evenly.
why: Taking apart, Crane loosens the gland bolts first, then the bonnet nuts, and takes the packing out once the bonnet is off.
needs: bonnet_bolts
Pack the stem when the bonnet is bolted down.
Take the gland off and the packing out before the bonnet nuts.

text: Sling the actuator over the stem onto the yoke's top flange and turn its handwheel until the flanges meet.
why: Crane takes a motor operated valve's operator off first: its mounting bolts out, then it is unscrewed off the stem by turning the handwheel towards closed, and lifted off. AUMA screws the output drive onto the stem first and sets the actuator on it, its dogs engaging.
needs: packing
Pack the stem before the actuator goes on.
Take the actuator off before the packing.

text: The stem nut turns in the actuator's output drive, on the stem's thread.
why: AUMA takes the stem nut out of the output drive (its spigot ring off) to machine it to the stem's thread, and greases it going back.
needs: actuator
The stem nut is the actuator's output drive: set the actuator on first.
Take the stem nut out of the actuator once it is off the valve.

text: The local display is in the actuator's controls' cover.
needs: actuator
The display is the actuator's: set the actuator on first.
It comes off with the actuator.

text: Put the handwheel on its input shaft and fit its retaining ring.
needs: actuator
The handwheel is the actuator's: set the actuator on first.
Take the handwheel off once the actuator is off the valve.

text: Fit the actuator's mounting bolts and tighten them crosswise.
why: Isolate the actuator's supply before anything is undone.
needs: actuator
The bolts hold the actuator's flange: set it on first.
Take the mounting bolts out first.
handwheel
Turn the handwheel to bring the flanges together before the bolts.
Take the bolts out before the handwheel comes off.
